assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent modular cutout sprite atlas for native Canvas 2D skeletal animation. Input image 1 is the already approved original pet identity, painting and color reference. Transform it into ONE atlas of detached anatomy parts preserving exact cute face, colors, proportions and richly shaded hand-painted 2D contour style. True transparent background, no checkerboard pixels, no shadow, no text, no labels, no frame, no complete assembled character. Square canvas, layout EXACTLY a 3 columns by 3 rows equally-sized grid with each detached part centered entirely in its own cell and at least 8 percent empty margin inside every cell; no overlap or touching between cells. Every part must have clean finished contours and generously padded rounded hidden attachment root for rotation without cracks. All parts face RIGHT in matching three-quarter side view, consistent light above-left. No body parts baked onto other body parts; detached limbs include paws/feet; body has no head and no arms/legs. Nothing is a full character pose. Subject same honey golden-brown little monkey with cream face, amber eyes, gold scroll headband, red scarf. Grid row1 left: ONE complete head including both round ears and headband, cream peach face and lively smile, neck below; row1 middle: ONE plump headless furry torso with cream belly, no arms no legs no tail; row1 right: ONE thick curled furry tail, round root at lower right. Row2 left: ONE near/front bent arm with pale paw, shoulder root at upper left, paw at lower right; row2 middle: ONE far/back bent arm with pale paw in same orientation; row2 right: ONE separate flowing vermilion scarf with small knot root at right, trailing two short cloth points to left. Row3 left: ONE near/front short bent leg and broad cream foot, thigh root top; row3 middle: ONE far/back short bent leg and foot; row3 right: ONE alternate complete head with same exact identity but enthusiastic open mouth for pounce; ears and crown preserved. Head much larger than torso to reproduce original toddler proportions. Do not add weapon.
